Name compatibility calculator

Compare two names using Chaldean numerology and see how their name numbers sit together.

Name Compatibility Calculator
Uses Chaldean name-numerology to compare the hidden numeric value of two names.
Chaldean numerology, a classic alternate numbering system to Pythagorean numerology. For entertainment only.

How name numerology works

In Chaldean numerology every letter carries a value from 1 to 8. The calculator adds up the letters of each name and reduces the total to a single digit, which is that name's number. It then compares the two numbers and shows how closely they harmonise.

Chaldean values differ from the more familiar Pythagorean system, so a name number here may not match one you have seen on another site. Neither is wrong — they are two traditions.

What a harmony score can tell you

Numerologists use name numbers to talk about how two people express themselves and where they may pull in different directions. It is a starting point for reflection rather than a judgement on a relationship. For a full numerology reading that also uses your date of birth, speak to a numerologist.

Frequently asked

Common questions

Which numerology system does this use?

Chaldean numerology, in which letters are valued from 1 to 8 and the number 9 is not assigned to any letter.

Should I use my full name?

Numerologists usually work with the name you are known by day to day. Try both your first name and your full name and see how they compare.

Can a name change improve compatibility?

Some numerologists suggest spelling changes, but that is a decision to discuss properly with a numerologist rather than one to make from a single score.
